_comment: Sheet group names -> department slot. The short code (ВШ1 …) is what goes into the sheet's drop-down; the full CRM names are accepted as synonyms, and any name containing «ВШ<число>» is matched by that number (see RosterConfig). The look of the hero standing in a slot is NOT fixed here: it is chosen in the admin page (tab «Герои») and defaults to heroRoster.json.
